question: After the frozen native grammar, trigger, carrier, Ward, Shatter, action-economy and complete competing-option closures, does exact current-main contain any direct Dusk-core runtime state consumer that has not received a scientific decision?

scientificBasis.coverageRule: Facet and Shatter are already closed source families. Enumerate every executable CombatRules line that reads or writes cb.embers, ember_cap or gain_embers, then map every containing function once to fixed context, an exact prior closure or an unclosed direct state consumer.
scientificBasis.completenessBoundary: This is source-complete for exact current-main direct Ember-state runtime surfaces. It does not claim that all imaginable new primitives or all arbitrary pairs of generic card effects are exhausted.
scientificBasis.selectionRule: Exactly one unclosed direct consumer may receive a separate zero-row capacity preregistration. No outcome, support count, fitted score, simulator row or qualitative ranking enters this audit.
scientificBasis.mechanisticDistinctness: Crown of the Hearth converts the unspent terminal Ember reserve into post-combat HP. It is not Novaflare reserve damage, Emberdance reserve Ward, automatic Lantern Art spend, an in-combat Weak extension, a voluntary-loss mark, a victory-quality threshold or a generic healing scalar.

runtimeSurfaceCoverage.reason: No current authored Art has an Ember effect; this generic handler has no current carrier.
Direct card Ember production is part of the frozen Kindle and Ember producer context; it is not a payoff by itself.

lines: hit_enemy(run, cb, target, _ji(fx["n"]) * cb.embers, true, damage_mult)
runtimeSurfaceCoverage.reason: Devour is recovery context, emberNova reserve damage is closed, and Emberdance reserve Ward is the closed Kindle/Ward family.
This boss relic changes Ember supply and capacity but supplies no independent payoff; it becomes a producer or interference factor only after a consumer has capacity.
Enemy death is a universal core Ember source, not an independently selectable payoff.
Dusk Shatter and Prism Charm Ember production belong to the exact closed Shatter family.
Pyreheart was explicitly retained only as an unassumed producer in the now-closed complete Ember-reserve damage family.
The exact shipped boss relic directly consumes the terminal Ember reserve for post-combat healing, and no prior #421 scientific decision names this consumer family.
